customer.business: Caça ao Preço Beleza (grupo de WhatsApp só de achados de beleza da Shopee, com link de afiliado)
customer.target: Brazilian women, CLT workers earning R$ 2,000 to R$ 3,000 a month, who are already members of a Shopee beauty deals WhatsApp group (income below is per year in R$)

segments.name: Jovem de 20 a 28 anos começando a cuidar da pele
Mulher de 30 a 45 anos que já tem rotina de skincare
Compra para si e para presentear mãe, irmã e amigas

behaviours.name: Compra por impulso
behaviours.how: Vê uma oferta boa no celular e compra na hora, sem pesquisar muito.

behaviours.name: Caçadora de desconto
behaviours.how: Só compra com cupom ou promoção e compara com farmácia e outros sites.

behaviours.name: Silenciou o grupo
behaviours.how: Entrou num grupo de ofertas, silenciou e só abre de vez em quando.

behaviours.name: Segue influenciadora de skincare
behaviours.how: Compra o que a influenciadora que ela confia indicou e pesquisa o ativo antes.

behaviours.name: Compra só o necessário
behaviours.how: Orçamento apertado, repõe só o que acabou (protetor, sabonete, hidratante).

behaviours.name: Fiel à farmácia ou à loja de marca
behaviours.how: Compra beleza na farmácia ou na loja da marca para ter certeza de que é original.

habits: you check WhatsApp on the bus to and from work
you get paid on the 5th and money is tight after the 20th
you watch skincare and makeup videos on TikTok and Instagram at night
you have the Shopee app installed and bought there before

pitch:
You are already a member of "Caça ao Preço Beleza", a free WhatsApp group for women with about 600 members that posts only beauty deals from Shopee with an affiliate link (buying through the link costs you nothing extra).
The group posts beauty and skincare deals every day: micellar water, cleansing gel, vitamin C, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, moisturizer, facial sunscreen, acne patches, makeup. Brands like Bioderma, L'Oréal, Garnier and Dermage appear, alongside cheaper brands.
Every product has at least 30% real discount, costs up to R$ 300, and stores with bad reviews or suspected fakes are filtered out. The group also shares simple guides, like "skincare step by step: what each product does and when to use it".
"Buys" means: in your first month in the group, you buy at least one product through a group link. The price questions are about a typical beauty product posted in the group.
